hero.title: A Hong Kong-based B2B solutions company.
hero.lead: R3R combines data-driven thinking, hands-on supply chain experience and strong engineering support.

body: R3R is a Hong Kong-based B2B integrated solutions company. We work with overseas buyers who need Chinese manufacturing executed properly — from supplier selection and sampling through production, consolidation and final delivery.

On the energy side, we coordinate customized storage, PV and EMS projects with our engineering partners. On the supply chain side, we run general merchandise programs across a global logistics network.
Our role is coordination and accountability: one point of contact, clear milestones, and delivery that can be verified.
